_comment: The jester in the wood (2026-09-30): a fight inside one 3D set, with physics. See _make_forest_fight_0930.py.
title: THE JESTER IN THE WOOD
logline: On a path through a dangerous wood, a grinning jester drops from a tree, and she burns it down.
grade: 2D anime film, hand-drawn cel animation, painted backgrounds, a dark fantasy forest at dusk, shafts of low sunlight through the canopy, drifting mist.
avoid: lowres, blurry, morphing, warping, melting, flicker, deformed hands, extra fingers, extra limbs, two of the same person, subtitles, captions, watermark, nsfw
score_tags: dark fantasy anime score, taiko drums, tense strings, a music-box motif, instrumental, no vocals

place.prompt: A dense, dangerous fantasy forest with a dirt path down the middle, painted as an anime background.

shots.name: the path
shots.title: the path
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. High above a dark, dense fantasy forest at dusk, a narrow dirt path winds between huge gnarled trees, shafts of low sunlight cutting through drifting mist. A young woman with long wavy sea-green hair, a red dress, a lilac sash and red boots walks alone along the path, small far below. The camera glides slowly forward and down. Sound: wind in the canopy, a distant crow, creaking branches, footsteps on dirt. No music.
shots.avoid_extra: 3d render, cgi, photorealistic, live action, a crowd, other people, blood, gore

shots.name: he drops
shots.title: he drops
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. From behind the young woman with long sea-green hair, in the foreground on the forest path: ahead, a lanky harlequin jester in a purple-and-yellow diamond costume and a purple-and-yellow two-horned cap, with a chalk-white face and a wide red grin crouches on a huge branch over the path, then leaps down onto the path in front of her in a shower of falling leaves and twigs, lands in a crouch and rises slowly, grinning. She stops dead. Sound: a high giggle, rustling, a thud on the dirt. No music.

shots.name: blows
shots.title: blows
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. Side view on the forest path: the grinning jester in his purple-and-yellow diamond costume lunges at the young woman with long sea-green hair and a red dress with a fast punch; she blocks with both forearms, then kicks him in the chest; he skids back along the dirt, kicking up pebbles, and straightens, giggling. Sound: a whoosh, the thump of the block, the kick, scattering pebbles, his laughter. No music.

shots.name: fire
shots.title: fire
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. Over her shoulder: she thrusts both hands forward and a blazing fireball bursts from them and streaks along the path; the jester flips aside; the fireball slams into the huge old tree behind him - the trunk explodes in fire and splinters, and the whole tree topples and crashes across the path in a storm of leaves and dust. Sound: the roar of the fireball, an explosion, splintering wood, the crash of the tree. No music.

shots.name: the fallen oak
shots.title: the fallen oak
shots.prompt: 2D anime, hand-drawn cel animation. The huge fallen tree lies across the forest path, smoke and dust drifting, embers glowing on its shattered trunk; the jester in his purple-and-yellow diamond costume crouches on top of the trunk, head tilted, giggling; the young woman with long sea-green hair and a red dress faces him from the path, her hands rising to cast again. Sound: crackling embers, settling debris, his giggle, wind. No music.
